lunyoro: Kandi omuzimu omubi obuguruga omu muntu, gugenda omu byeya ebyomere, nuguse’ra hokuhumura, gutarukuzora.

english: “He is a prophet,” the man answered.
lunyoro: Kandi bagaruka nibagamba omufu wamaiso ngu Iwe nomweta oha, baitu akakuigura amaiso gawe? Nauwe yagamba ati Nuwe nabi.

english: “Then he will say to those on his left, ‘Away from me, you that are under God's curse! Away to the eternal fire which has been prepared for the Devil and his angels!
lunyoro: Nubwo aligambira abo abahamukonogwe ogwemoso Mundugeho inywena abakyenerwe mumugende mumu’ro ogutahwaho, ogwatekanizibwe Setani nabamaraikabe;

english: Simon Peter went aboard and dragged the net ashore full of big fish, a hundred and fifty-three in all; even though there were so many, still the net did not tear.
lunyoro: Simoni Petero yagwe’ramu nacundira ekisoga ha musa, kiijuire encu enkoto, kikumi mwatano mu isatu: baitu nobuzikaba ziri nyingi ziti, ekisoha kitacweke.

english: They will see his face, and his name will be written on their foreheads.

english: and bring glory to your people Israel.”
All ate the same spiritual bread
lunyoro: kandi bona balyaga ebyokulya ebimu ebyomwoyo;

english: Then it will be a private matter. And your Father, who sees what you do in private, will reward you.
lunyoro: okugabira kwawe kkuikalege okwensita: nukwo ’So anyakurora omunsita alikuha empera,

english: The scripture says, “Abraham believed God, and because of his faith God accepted him as righteous.”
lunyoro: Baitu ebyahandikirwe nobigamba bita? Ngu Iburahimu akaikiriza Ruhanga, kandi kikatekerezebwa haluwe okuba okuhiki’ra.

english: Agrippa said to Paul, “In this short time do you think you will make me a Christian?”
lunyoro: Manyire oikirize. Agulipa yagambira Paulo ati Nokuhambiriza okutaito nogonza okunfora Omukristayo.

english: “Jesus of Nazareth,” they said.
lunyoro: Yesu yagaruka nabakaguza ati Nimuse’ra oha? Bagamba bgu Yesu owa Nazalesi.

english: You are also God's building.
lunyoro: Baitu tuli bakozi hamu na Ruhanga: inywe muli musiri gwa Ruhanga, muli enju ya Ruhanga.

english: At every Passover Festival Pilate was in the habit of setting free any one prisoner the people asked for.
lunyoro: Kandi ha bugenyi yabaleke’raga omunyankomo omu. Oubamusabire.

english: Sell all your belongings and give the money to the poor. Provide for yourselves purses that don't wear out, and save your riches in heaven, where they will never decrease, because no thief can get to them, and no moth can destroy them.
lunyoro: Mugule ebimuyinabyo, mugabe ebyokuganyira; mweko’re emyeko etarukukura, itungo eryomu iguru eritahwaho, nambere omusuma atai’ra haihi, nobwekuba enyenje okusisa.

english: But we belong to God. Whoever knows God listens to us; whoever does not belong to God does not listen to us. This, then, is how we can tell the difference between the Spirit of truth and the spirit of error.
lunyoro: Itwe tuli ba Ruhanga: nyakumanya Ruhanga atuhu’ra Itwe; aturukumanya Ruhanga tahu’ra itwe. Nuho turukumanyira omwoyo ogwamazima nomwoyo ogwokuhabisa.

english: One of them, named Agabus, stood up and by the power of the Spirit predicted that a severe famine was about to come over all the earth. (It came when Claudius was emperor.)
lunyoro: Kandi hakeme'ra omu hali abo, ibaralye Agabo, naragura Habwomwoyo ati Haliba ekiihekingi omu nsi zona: eki kyabaho omu biro bya Karaudio.

english: All who heard it were amazed at what the shepherds said.
lunyoro: Bona abahulire bakahuni’ra ebi abalisa ebibabatebize.

english: I was hungry but you would not feed me, thirsty but you would not give me a drink;
lunyoro: baitu nkaba nyine enjara mutampe ebyokulya; nkaba nyine iroho mutanywise;

english: So then, whatever you have said in the dark will be heard in broad daylight, and whatever you have whispered in private in a closed room will be shouted from the housetops.
lunyoro: Nukwo byona ebimwagambire omu muirima kirihuli’rwa omu musana; neki ekimwagambire omu kutu ha kaifo, kiridumirwa eruguru ha nju.

english: What I meant was that you should not associate with a person who calls himself a believer but is immoral or greedy or worships idols or is a slanderer or a drunkard or a thief. Don't even sit down to eat with such a person.
lunyoro: baitu hati bunu mbahandikire okutaterana hamu mbahandikire okutaterana hamu nomuntu wena anyakweta mwene wanyu obwaba ali musihani, rundi omwegombi, eundi aramya ebisisani, rundi omujuni, rundi omutamizi, rundi omuhogozi: anyakusisa ati nobukwakuba okulya nauwe.

english: They were all crying as they hugged him and kissed him good-bye.
lunyoro: Kandi bona ba'ra muno, nibamugwa omu bikya Paulo,

english: an elder must be without fault; he must have only one wife,
lunyoro: nka nyowe okunakuragire; omuntu obwatabaho omusango, anyina omukazi omu, anyina abana abarukuikiriza, abatalegwa nka’abagu biraro nibubakuba

english: When you forgive people for what they have done, I forgive them too. For when I forgive—if, indeed, I need to forgive anything—I do it in Christ's presence because of you,
lunyoro: Baitu wena oumuganyira, nanyowe ’muganyira: nanyowe ekinganyira, obundaba ninganyira, (nkiganyire) habwanyu omu maiso ga Kristo:

english: So do not be afraid; you are worth much more than many sparrows!
lunyoro: Nikyo mutalitinira: inywe nimukira muno ebisirya bingi.

english: Guard against turning back from the grace of God. Let no one become like a bitter plant that grows up and causes many troubles with its poison.
lunyoro: nimurora muno rundi haleke okubaho omuntu wena atarukukika omu mbabazi za Ruhanga; noba kireke okumera nokubatuntuza, na baingi nibisisikara;

english: Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. I was born and came into the world for this one purpose, to speak about the truth. Whoever belongs to the truth listens to me.”
lunyoro: Pirato yamugambira ati kandi iwe oli omukama? Yesu yagarukamu ati Nukwo ogambire, baitu nyowe ndi omukama. Nyowe nikyo nazalirwe, nikyo naizire omu nsi, ndange amananu. Owamananu wena ahu’ra iraka lyange.

english: riding on a young donkey.”
lunyoro: Otatina omuisiki wa Sayuni: dora, Omukama wawe naija, atembere omwana gwenkaina.

english: like servants who are waiting for their master to come back from a wedding feast. When he comes and knocks, they will open the door for him at once.
lunyoro: netabaza zanyu zakege; nainywe muikalege nkabantu abategereza mukama wabu, obwaligaruka okuruga omu bugenyi bwobugole; obwaliija nayeranga bamukingu’reho bwango.

english: then a poor widow came along and dropped in two little copper coins, worth about a penny.
lunyoro: Kandi hakaija omufakati omu owamasege, yanagamu obucweka bubiri, niyo kodolante.

english: Then he walked over and touched the coffin, and the men carrying it stopped. Jesus said, “Young man! Get up, I tell you!”
lunyoro: Yai’ra haihi, yakora ha ruhinyo, abetweki bayeme’ra. Yagamba ati Omwojo, ninkugambira nti Imuka.

english: Before some men who had been sent by James arrived there, Peter had been eating with the Gentile believers. But after these men arrived, he drew back and would not eat with the Gentiles, because he was afraid of those who were in favor of circumcising them.
lunyoro: Baitu ira, abantu abamu batakaizire okuruga owa Yakobo, yalyaga Nabamahanga: baitu abo obubaizire yayehinya nayesororamu, atinire abo abo abokusarwa.

english: Through him God gave me the privilege of being an apostle for the sake of Christ, in order to lead people of all nations to believe and obey.
lunyoro: ayatuhaisize embabazi nobukwenda obwokuhu’ra okurukuruga omu kuikiriza, omuli Amahanga gona habwibaralye:

english: You know very well that we did not come to you with flattering talk, nor did we use words to cover up greed—God is our witness!
lunyoro: Baitu titukabaga omu kigambo kyokutebora nkokumumanyire, nobukyakuba ekisweke’ra obugobya, Ruhanga nuwe kaiso:

english: Then they crucified two bandits with Jesus, one on his right and the other on his left.
lunyoro: Nabahura babiribakabambwa ahamu nauwe, ondi ha Mukono ogwobulyo, ondi ha gwemoso.

english: I may give away everything I have, and even give up my body to be burned
lunyoro: Kandi obundaba nindisa abasege ebinyinabyo byona, kandi obundaba nimpayo omubiri gwange okwokebwa omu’ro, kunu ntanyina kugonza, tikingasira na kake.

english: Jesus sent Peter and John with these instructions: “Go and get the Passover meal ready for us to eat.”
lunyoro: Kandi uwe akatuma Petero na Yohana nagamba ati Mugende mututekanirize Okuhingurwaho, tulye.

english: Then Paul called one of the officers and said to him, “Take this young man to the commander; he has something to tell him.”
lunyoro: Kandi Paulo yayeta namberali omu hali abanyakihanda, nagamba ati Twara omusigazi onu hali engabwa enkuru: baitu ayina ekyokumutebeza.

english: My inner being delights in the law of God.
lunyoro: baitu ninsemere’rwa ebiragiro bya Ruhanga omu muntu womunda:

english: So then, if food makes a believer sin, I will never eat meat again, so as not to make a believer fall into sin.
lunyoro: Nukwo ebyokulya biraba nibitabaijura mugenzi wange, tindirya enyama ebiro byona, ndeke okutabaijuru mugenzi wange.

english: But if we obey his word, we are the ones whose love for God has really been made perfect. This is how we can be sure that we are in union with God:
lunyoro: baitu wena anyakukwata ekigambokye, mazimakwo omuluwe omuluwe okugonza kwa Ruhanga kukahikirizibwa. Nuho turukumanyira ngu tuli omuluwe:

english: But the Jews stirred up the leading men of the city and the Gentile women of high social standing who worshiped God. They started a persecution against Paul and Barnabas and threw them out of their region.
lunyoro: Baitu Abayudaya bakahere'ra abakazi abekengi ebikitinisa, nabakuru abomu rubuga, bahigana Paulo na Baranaba, bababinga omu mitano yabu.

english: But Peter denied it, “Woman, I don't even know him!”
lunyoro: Baitu yayehakana nagamba ati Omukazi ti’mumanyire.

english: I know that you always listen to me, but I say this for the sake of the people here, so that they will believe that you sent me.”
lunyoro: Kandi Nkamanya nti ompu’ra ebiro byona: baitu ngambire habwekitebe ekinyehingulirize, baikirize niwe wantumire.

english: But if we say, ‘From human beings …’” (They were afraid of the people, because everyone was convinced that John had been a prophet.)
lunyoro: Baitu obuturaba ntuganba ngu Kukaruga omu Bantu_ bakatina abantu: baitu bona bakatekereza mali Yohana okuba nabi.

english: The crowd that gathered around him was so large that he got into a boat and sat in it, while the crowd stood on the shore.
lunyoro: Ebitebe bingi byamuso’rokaniraho, yagwe’ra omu bwato, yaika’ra; ekitebe kyona kyemerire ha musa.

english: If we say that we know him, but do not obey his commands, we are liars and there is no truth in us.
lunyoro: Anyakuganba ati mumanyire, kunu takwata ebiragirobye, ogu mubihi, kunu amazima tigali omuluwe.

english: Let no one become immoral or unspiritual like Esau, who for a single meal sold his rights as the older son.
lunyoro: Kandi hatabaho omusihani wena, rundi atarukutina Ruhanga, nka Esau ayaguzire obugwetwa bwe wenka obwakaihuro ankamu akabyokulya.

english: It would have been much better for them never to have known the way of righteousness than to know it and then turn away from the sacred command that was given them.
lunyoro: Baitu kyakubaire kirungi namberebali kuba bataramanyire omuhanda gwokuhiki’ra, okukira, okugarukayo enyuma okuleka ekiragiro ekirukwera ekibahairwe.

english: After this, Jesus himself sent out through his disciples from the east to the west the sacred and everliving message of eternal salvation.]
lunyoro: Uwe yagenda yatebeza abaikaraga ohamu nauwe, bakaba nibaganya niba’ra.

english: So John said to all of them, “I baptize you with water, but someone is coming who is much greater than I am. I am not good enough even to untie his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.
lunyoro: Yohana yagarukamu nabagambira bona ati Mananukwo nyowe, orukoba rwenkaitoze tinsukuseme’ra okuruboho’ra; ogu alibabatiza Nomwyo Ogurukwera nomu’ro:

english: He chose what the world looks down on and despises and thinks is nothing, in order to destroy what the world thinks is important.
lunyoro: kandi ebyobugara ebyensi Ruhanga akabikomamu, akwase ensoni ebyamani: kandi nebitali byekitinisa ebyensi nebigayibwa Ruhanga akabikomamu, kandi nebitaloho, nukwo aburanganize ebiroho:

english: to preach the message, to insist upon proclaiming it (whether the time is right or not), to convince, reproach, and encourage, as you teach with all patience.

english: You must, of course, continue faithful on a firm and sure foundation, and must not allow yourselves to be shaken from the hope you gained when you heard the gospel. It is of this gospel that I, Paul, became a servant—this gospel which has been preached to everybody in the world.

english: Paul stood up in front of the city council and said, “I see that in every way you Athenians are very religious.
lunyoro: Inywe abasaija Abasene, mboine omu byona nimutina muno abacwezi.

english: He came to me, stood by me, and said, ‘Brother Saul, see again!’ At that very moment I saw again and looked at him.
lunyoro: akaija hali nyowe, yayeme'ra namberendi, nangambira ati Mwene waitu Saulo, iguka. Kandi omu kasumi ako nubwo nahwereze okumurora.

english: Love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.’
lunyoro: kandi ogonzege Mukama Ruhanga wawe nimutima gwawe gwona, nobwomezi bwawe bwona, namagezi gawe gona, namani gawe gona.

lunyoro: Hasigaireho omurundi gumu nyowe nditengesa teri ensi yonka,, baitu niguru.

english: God did what he had purposed, and made known to us the secret plan he had already decided to complete by means of Christ.
lunyoro: obuyatumanyisize ensita zebi ebiyagondeze, nkokuyasimire wenka, nkokuyamalirire ira omuluwe, obwobuketo o bwempiko zebiro,

lunyoro: Mugaende bwango, mutebeze abegeswabe ngu Ahumbukire omu bafu; kandi dora, nabebembera okugeda Galiraya; nuho mulimuro’ra: dora mbagambire.

english: My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me.
lunyoro: Entama zange zihu’ra iraka lyange, nanyowe nzimanya, nazo zinkuratira:

english: Women should learn in silence and all humility.

lunyoro: Nekitebe kikaba kiikalire bamwehingulirize;bamugambira ngu Dora, nyoko na bene banyu bali aheru, nibakuse’ra.

english: since they have to do only with food, drink, and various purification ceremonies. These are all outward rules, which apply only until the time when God will establish the new order.
lunyoro: nizo engeso eziragirwa ezomubiri kwonka, (hamu nezokulya, nezokunywa, nezokwoga okwemiringo nyingi) ezatairweho okuhikya ebiro ebyokusemerezamu obuhyaka.

english: Some teachers of the Law who were sitting there thought to themselves,
lunyoro: Baitu hakaba haloho abahandiki abamu baikalire, nibatekereza omu mitima yabu

english: Pilate said to them the third time, “But what crime has he committed? I cannot find anything he has done to deserve death! I will have him whipped and set him free.”
lunyoro: Yabagambira obwakasatu ati Mara ekibi kiraha ekyakozire omuntu onu? Timboine omuluwe musango ogwokufa: nikyo ndamute’ra, ’mulekere.

english: I begged Titus to go, and I sent the other believer with him. Would you say that Titus took advantage of you? Do not he and I act from the very same motives and behave in the same way?
lunyoro: Nkagambi’ra Tito. Kandi nkatuma mwene waitu hamu nauwe. Rundi Tito akabasagisamu amagoba? Tutagendere omu Mwoyo omu? Tutagendere omu bigere binu?

english: They all ate and had enough, and the disciples took up twelve baskets of what was left over.
lunyoro: Kandi balya nibaguta bona: kandi basoroza oburagalika obwabasagirire ebigega ikumi nebibiri.

english: But Jesus answered, “Rather, how happy are those who hear the word of God and obey it!”
lunyoro: Baitu yagamba ati Okukira, banyina omugisa abarukuhu’ra ekigambo kya Ruhanga nibakikwata.

english: They were looking for Jesus, and as they gathered in the Temple, they asked one another, “What do you think? Surely he will not come to the festival, will he?”
lunyoro: Kandi base’ra Yesu nibagambiragana, bemerire omu yekaru ngu Nimutekereza muta? Tarukuija ha bugenyi?

english: They love the best places at feasts and the reserved seats in the synagogues;
lunyoro: nibaraihya ebitutu, nibagonza ebikaro ebyahagati ha bugenyi, nentebe ezekitinisa omu maso’rokaniro

english: Mary stayed about three months with Elizabeth and then went back home.
lunyoro: Kandi Malyamu akaikara nauwe amezi asatu, yagarukayo owabu.

english: “We heard him say, ‘I will tear down this Temple which men have made, and after three days I will build one that is not made by men.’”
lunyoro: Itwe tukamuhu’ra nagamba ati Ndisesa yekaru enu enyakukozirwe nemikono, kandi ebiro bisatu numwo ndyombekeramu endi etarukukorwa nemikono.

english: But now I tell you: if you are angry
lunyoro: baitu nyowe nimbagagambira nti Omuntu wena anyakubihi’rwa mwene wabu, aligwe’rwa omusango; nauwe anyakugambira mwene wabu ati Mugwagwa, buli amalize kunagwa omu Gehena eyomu’ro.

english: But the evil spirit said to them, “I know Jesus, and I know about Paul; but you—who are you?”
lunyoro: Kandi omuzimu omubi gwagarukamu nugubagambira ngu Yesu mumanyire, na Paulo mumanyire, baitu inywe muli boha?

english: Yet I must be on my way today, tomorrow, and the next day; it is not right for a prophet to be killed anywhere except in Jerusalem.
lunyoro: Baitu kimpikirire okwegendera nyenka hati na nyenkya na ijweri: baitu tikisoboka nabi okuhwereke’ra aheru ya Yerusalemu.

english: But in that case, how could the Scriptures come true which say that this is what must happen?”
lunyoro: Kandi birahiki’ra bita ebyahandikirwe ngu Kisemire okuba kiti?

english: Paul answered, “I am a Jew, born in Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of an important city. Please let me speak to the people.”
lunyoro: Baitu Paulo yagamba ati Nyowe ndi Muyudaya, owa Taruso orwa Kirikiya, owomu rubuga orutali rwokugayibwa: kandi nkwesengerize leka ngambire abantu.

english: The message given to our ancestors by the angels was shown to be true, and those who did not follow it or obey it received the punishment they deserved.
lunyoro: Baitu ekigambo ekyagambirwe bamaraika obukiraba kyagumireho, kandi nekyokusisa kyona nobutahu'ra bwona biraba byahairwe empera yobulyo;

english: He answered them, “Why did you have to look for me? Didn't you know that I had to be in my Father's house?”
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Mukanseru’ra ki? Mutamanye ngu kimpikirire okuikara omu bigambo bya Isenyowe?

english: The Lord answered, “Who, then, is the faithful and wise servant? He is the one that his master will put in charge, to run the household and give the other servants their share of the food at the proper time.
lunyoro: Mukama waitu yagamba ati Araha ogu omuketo owokwesiga owamagezi, omukama we owalisigira abomu njuye, okubagabiraga omugabo gwabu ogwebyokulya omu kasumi kabyo?

english: If you show more respect to the well-dressed man and say to him, “Have this best seat here,” but say to the poor man, “Stand over there, or sit here on the floor by my feet,”
lunyoro: nainywe nimutangi'ra ogu ajwaire ebyokwecuma, nimugamba nu Iwe yeme'ra kuli, rundi ngu Ika'ra hansi yakatebe kebigere byange;

english: You are the children of your father, the Devil, and you want to follow your father's desires. From the very beginning he was a murderer and has never been on the side of truth, because there is no truth in him. When he tells a lie, he is only doing what is natural to him, because he is a liar and the father of all lies.
lunyoro: Muli ba isinywe Setani, kandi nimugonza okukora okwegomba kwa isnywe,Ogu okuruga kara na kara akabali muisi; takaikaraha omu mananu, baitu amananu busamu omuluwe. Obwabiha ebisuba buli agamba ebye, baitu ogu mubihi, nuwe ise ebisuba.

english: Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu akagonza Maliza nomanyina na Lazaro.

english: Jesus reached out and touched him. “I do want to,” he answered. “Be clean!” At once the disease left the man.
lunyoro: Yago’ra omukonogwe, yamukoraho, nagamba ati Ningonza; semezebwa. Ahonaho ebigenge byamurugaho.

english: Christ has been divided
lunyoro: Rundi Kristo abaganizibwemu? Rundi Paulo akabaganizibwa ha muti habwanyu? Rundi mukabatizibwa okutaha omu ibara lya Paulo?

english: Those who speak on their own authority are trying to gain glory for themselves. But he who wants glory for the one who sent him is honest, and there is nothing false in him.
